scope: Frozen worker/protocol independent scientific static review, metadata/fold replay and synthetic pure-logic checks. Final manifest and live resource/progenitor closure remain separate ROOT/resource-review gates.

verified_scope.details: Worker hash-checks pinned inputs, binds split hash to frozen protocol, compares per-ID identity/Chinese-kind/origin/source/Excel-column fields against metadata and user-confirmed registry/18-table mapping, rejects duplicate IDs/physical IDs/columns and verifies original855 historical roles. Independent prior review verified all1672 current rows, historical855 inheritance and added817 role replay.

New fixed control selects only516 master-TRAIN rows from 枣仁/酸枣仁. Only their explicit absorption-sheet Excel columns and coordinate column enter the guarded numeric decoder. Raw workbook hash equals registry hash before and after extraction. CAL/PRED vectors are not constructed or transformed. Container hashing/XML traversal necessarily reads workbook bytes, which is correctly distinguished from numeric spectral extraction.

Only original shared612 finite increasing points in inclusive0.1..1.5 are allowed; differing axes fail rather than interpolate. No IDs/path/kind/origin metadata become numerical predictors. SNV is the exact hash-bound pinned _snv AST function: per-row ddof1 and constant-spectrum rejection. StandardScaler fits fold-training only; sourcegroup-held rows receive transform only.

PCG64 seed20261108 in fixed kind order on sorted group IDs exactly reproduces five frozen pairs. Each516 TRAIN physical specimen is held once per control; no held sourcegroup crosses its fold fit pool. Master CAL/PRED roles remain excluded.

Exactly5 real fixed-SVM fold fits plus3 prespecified seeds×5 fit-label permutations =20 calls. All parameters remain C10/gamma scale/balanced/SVC vote/random_state42. Each seed uses SeedSequence([20261108,seed,fold]); fit-label counts are preserved, held truth and features are unchanged. No hyperparameter/seed search or result-triggered omission is implemented. Unknown predicted kinds are rejected.

Each control has516 unique OOF IDs, exact correct/N, macroF1, balanced accuracy, per-kind recall, each sourcegroup N/correct/recall and unweighted mean of10 group recalls. Fold training/test kind counts and complete ID lists are retained. These are binary-kind recalls grouped by source, not a new origin-group classifier.

All six pinned task files are read as already frozen predictions, not refitted. Per-row truth/correctness/task/role and per-setting exact prediction-ID coverage are validated; predicted labels outside each task class set are rejected. Source-only and full-refit metrics are recomputed separately, preserving their distinct label budgets. Legacy OOF is only recoded after correction and is not called a new pure-kind experiment.

Frozen four-kind full-SVM gate plus prespecified true-kind source-only origin heads (acidR2; other kinds full-SVM) are joined by identical prediction record ID. Joint success is the conjunction of gate correctness and correctly routed origin correctness. Wrong gate routes are certain joint failures and receive NOT_COMPUTED_WRONG_ROUTE origin, not fabricated wrong-head predictions. Exact joint accuracy can be counted without computing those wrong-head outputs; full routed origin confusion and joint macroF1 remain NOT_COMPUTED.

Fit-started and fit-completed calls are recorded separately. Every completed fit invokes persistent partial receipts/predictions and event/progress output before the next fit, retaining completed negative outcomes and preventing completed fits being reported as zero after a later failure. A failed/in-flight call is not counted as a completed model. Real CPU closure remains supervisor wait4 evidence, not these model counters.

independent_executed_checks.method: AST-extract selected pure worker functions into an in-memory namespace; use synthetic516x612 numeric matrix and an injected constant-output fake estimator. No sklearn fit, real spectra or quantum kernels were invoked.

author_test_report.scope: Pure identities, fake estimators, synthetic XML boundaries, live-proof/preflight ordering and cold import with subprocess APIs forbidden. Reported zero new real fits/real spectral reads in tests.

required_interpretive_limits: All new control predictions concern master TRAIN development specimens. Historical exposure and this audit motivated after viewing previous results make it retrospective development evidence, not a new blind or external confirmation.

The5 folds hold source groups, not verified independent acquisition batches or botanically authenticated populations. All current batch_id fields are empty; no cross-batch/cross-instrument/cross-year claim is supported.

Fold0 has only6 jujube-kind fit specimens versus240 acid-kind fit specimens and holds270/516 records; it must be retained and reported even if poor. Dominant ZY01 contributes210/516=40.70% of overall accuracy. Unweighted10-group recall gives three singleton ZR groups30% of its weight. Report both aggregate metrics and eachgroup N/recall; neither weighting alone establishes stable population performance.

Three permutations are pipeline/label-signal negative controls only. They do not provide a valid permutation p-value, exchangeability across sourcegroups, a confidence interval or additional independent N. High null scores and low real scores must remain as results.
The20 calls create four predictions per original TRAIN specimen across real/three-null controls, not2064 independent physical samples. Three seeds do not enlarge N.

The frozen joint-correctness composition is retrospective evaluation of already chosen components. It is not a newly trained hierarchy, a complete wrong-route origin confusion matrix, or external end-to-end system validation. Do not multiply gate and origin marginal accuracies.
No new classifier selection, score-improving retries, calibration-strength choice, transfer pretraining or duplication of the foreign90000CPU queue is in this scientific scope.

conclusion_zh: 冻结worker与协议的科学流程审查通过，前提是最终manifest严格绑定本SHA并通过独立资源/前代闭合检查。逐样品标签与角色、新控制只读TRAIN光谱、来源组留出和置乱阴性对照、同ID联合正确计数均解释正确。保留fold0稀少枣仁条件与全部负结果，不把本轮开发诊断称为真实跨批次、独立外部验证或完整新分层系统。
